meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多步任务的计划、发现和进度存成文件,让 AI 助手分次推进并能接着上次继续
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务步骤很多、需要 AI 分多次完成并记住中间进展
copy.fit_line_en: For you if tasks take many steps and the AI must remember its progress across sessions

howto.what: 它会在项目里维护 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件当磁盘记忆:开工前先建计划,做决定前重读,每完成一步就更新进度、记录报错。上下文丢失或 /clear 后工作仍可续接。
howto.when: 当你要规划、拆解或整理一个多步骤项目、研究任务,或这项工作预计需要 5 次以上工具调用时接管;在 /clear 之后它也会自动恢复上下文。

say.text: 帮我规划这个多步骤任务,先写好 task_plan.md
say.note: 它会建计划文件并逐步更新进度

say.text: 把刚才的调研发现记进 findings.md
say.note: 关键发现会写到磁盘上

say.text: 接着上次的计划继续做
say.note: 它会读取已有规划文件恢复上下文

howto.what_en: It keeps task_plan.md, findings.md and progress.md in your project as working memory on disk: it writes a plan first, re-reads it before decisions, and updates progress and logs errors after each phase. Work survives context loss and /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan, break down or organize a multi-step project or research task, or when the work needs 5+ tool calls; after /clear it also recovers context automatically.

say_en.text: Help me plan this multi-step task and write task_plan.md first.
say_en.note: Creates the plan file and updates it.

say_en.text: Save what we just found into findings.md.
say_en.note: Key findings get written to disk.
It reads existing planning files to resume.
